newsitem.title: FINLAND: Cultor plans to sell Svenska Foder stake.
newsitem.headline: Cultor plans to sell Svenska Foder stake.

text.p: Finnish food, feed and bakery group Cultor Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it had signed a letter of intent with Danish company KFK about selling its 54.3 percent stake in Swedish Svenska Foder to KFK.

"Cultor ... and ... Korn- og Foderstof Kompagniet A/S (KFK) have signed a letter of intent aiming at selling Cultor's 54.3 percent holding in Svenska Foder AB to KFK," Cultor said, adding it expected to close the deal in early 1997.
Neither the price nor other financial details of the planned deal were given in the statement.
"For Cultor this is a further step to focus on high value-added and technology-intensive activities supported by strong positive cash generators," it said.
KFK is among the biggest companies in the Scandinavian agricultural sector with net sales of about 7.40 billion Danish crowns in 1995, Cultor said.

Cultor's divestment of Svenska Foder "will create a new agribusiness structure covering Denmark and the southern part of Sweden," it said, adding this would improve the overall competitiveness of the industry. In 1995, Svenska Foder's net sales were about 1.30 billion Swedish crowns. @
